ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. filed a daily report detailing its ongoing open market share buyback program. On September 25, 2026, the company repurchased 50,000 equity shares at an average price of ₹295.7971, bringing the cumulative total bought back to 1,638,324 shares. This action represents a deployment of capital aimed at reducing outstanding shares, potentially boosting shareholder value, and the filing itself is a routine regulatory disclosure with no immediate red flags.
